points.title: Failed first impression
points.desc: A visitor decides in 8 seconds. If your site looks outdated or doesn't work on mobile, they're already on your competitor's page.

points.title: Zero trust conveyed

about.headline: Clément Seguin, independent web designer.
paragraphs: I build websites for freelancers and SMBs. No agency, no intermediary — you work directly with me, from the first call to delivery.
My approach: a free mockup before any commitment, a custom design that reflects your business, and fast delivery so you can start turning visitors into clients.
about.currently: ✦ Available for new projects — reply within 24h.

items.q: Do I pay before seeing the result?
items.a: No. I design a complete mockup of your site before you put a single euro on the table. You only pay if the mockup convinces you.

items.q: What is included in the 5 days?
items.a: Design + development + go-live + domain configuration + working contact form + mobile and speed optimisation.

items.q: Do I keep ownership of my website?
items.a: Yes, 100%. Code, hosting, domain — everything is yours from day one. No hidden subscription, no lock-in.

items.q: What if I need changes after delivery?
items.a: Minor edits are included for the first month. After that, monthly maintenance at €150/month (2h of edits included + hosting + backups) or on demand.

items.q: I'm not technical — is that a problem?
items.a: That's exactly who I work for. You tell me about your business in plain language, I handle everything else. Nothing technical for you to manage.
